_about.purpose: Audit and metadata trail for MCP servers declared in .kilo/kilo.json. Kept SEPARATE from kilo.json so that Kilo's config round-trip never strips the human-readable metadata. The owner owns this file. Sync it manually if you change kilo.json.
_about.schema_safety_note: The fields in this file are NOT part of the official Kilo MCP schema. They exist solely for human-readable audit, rollback, and review purposes. They will never affect runtime behavior.

cloudflare-docs-mcp.notes: Read-only access to Cloudflare Workers, D1, R2, Durable Objects, Pages, Wrangler documentation. Uses mcp-remote as stdio-to-Streamable-HTTP proxy (recommended by Cloudflare for non-native Streamable HTTP clients). Used for: API reference lookup, schema examples, best practices during development.

cloudflare-bindings-mcp.notes: Read-only inspection of Cloudflare Workers runtime: D1 databases, R2 buckets, Durable Objects, KV namespaces. NO deploy permission. NO write access. NO secrets. Uses mcp-remote proxy. Will require OAuth flow on first connection (handled transparently by mcp-remote). 401 Unauthorized on raw GET is expected (MCP requires POST).

playwright-mcp.notes: Local Playwright MCP from Microsoft. --isolated mode ensures no persistent storage state between sessions. --headless for CI/safety. --browser=chromium for fastest startup. Used for: E2E browser testing, screenshot validation, console error detection, UI flow verification.
